purpose: 3.3V externally driven Schmitt inverter input stage with default-low bias and local bypass
application: Low-rate laboratory input/output test pads, output measured at high impedance

basis.ic: TI SCES218AA, pin table p4, recommended supply p6, electrical table p7, bypass recommendation p13, DBV land p37
basis.pulldown: 10k gives 0.33mA at 3.3V, 1.089mW; TI input leakage max 5uA gives 50mV estimate when otherwise undriven. These are design calculations, not measurements.
basis.bypass: TI recommends 0.1uF close to VCC; chosen X7R 100nF nominal, 16V part. Effective bias capacitance/transient response unmeasured.
basis.interfaces: Four project-designed 1.0x1.0mm copper test/solder contacts, no purchased connector body. Symbol electrical roles describe the external boundary.

layout_revision: Before the fresh frozen-artifact design: move C1 beside VCC; return GND through the clear gap between right-hand IC pads, reducing the source-trial long exterior bypass loop. No plane or via is added. Native clearance and every net must be checked again.

eco.purpose: Reduce high-level external driver load from 0.33mA to 0.15mA; estimated worst leakage bias becomes 0.11V; topology and all physical pads/routes unchanged
